name: The Flower Arrangement
source:
A short, storybook-like fantasy romance about the Forest Lord and his offered bride. Featuring six endings, you decide whether – and how – the lady says ‘I do’ or ‘I don’t.’

[From [url=https://waffrus.itch.io/the-flower-arrangement]Itch.io[/url]]
